findings.details: "OrbitNote" is marked as "Trusted" in Google Admin Console (allowing access to all Google data), but only 0 active user is currently utilizing it. Setting broad "Trusted" status increases potential blast radius if client credentials are compromised.
findings.remediation: Review this app in Google Admin Console (Security > API Controls > App Access Control). Consider scoping access down from "Trusted" to "Specific Google data" or restricting the policy to specific organizational units.
